title: Combat Camera - Configurable
author: my-mods
summary: Free the combat camera in all three modes: camera-directed targeting, fixed enemy selection, and untargeted combat. Toggle targeting with your normal lock button. When unlocked, attack toward the camera and block by the incoming attack direction.
